title: Hymns of the Early Church
author: brownlie
attributionNote: Recorded in the Christian Classics Ethereal Library under John (1857-1925) Brownlie (10 classics). The site catalogues the work at https://ccel.org/ccel/brownlie/earlyhymns, whose own card names the print edition transcribed here; where the site carries a title by a publisher's permission rather than in public domain, this library does not take it.
description: Hymns of the Early Church — the English text the Christian Classics Ethereal Library publishes for this work, on the site's Hymns shelf. The record was created by the CCEL import from the site's own catalogue and plain text; an editor's note for the work itself is still to be written.
historicalContext: Read in the Christian Classics Ethereal Library's catalogue, whose shelves follow the site's own division of Christian literature, and whose transcription follows the print edition London: Morgan & Scott LD, 1913.
availabilityNote: Complete in the Christian Classics Ethereal Library's plain-text edition: 8 chapter(s), 2624 paragraph(s), 14,350 words. The divisions are the headings of the site's own text, which the library stores rather than asking the site for again when the work is read. The text is public domain and is displayed with the library's credit.

texts.3.38: Thine be the glory, God of Light,
texts.3.39: For all the joy from morn that springs;
texts.3.40: Oh, may a morn dispel each night,
texts.3.41: And bless our lives with beauteous things.
texts.3.42: Give us this day the light that dwells
texts.3.43: In every heart Thy presence fills;
texts.3.44: That night with all its fears dispels,
texts.3.45: And life, and hope, and joy instils.
texts.3.46: Then shall our nights no darkness bring,
texts.3.47: But morn, bright morn, for ever shine;
texts.3.48: And when night spreads her dusky wings,
texts.3.49: More bright shall be the light Divine.

texts.3.53: Now, and while endless ages run.
